stories.title: Asian Games Women's Softball — Day 1 Live in Anjō, Japan

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Women's softball at the 2026 Asian Games is LIVE.

8 nations at Anjō Sports Park in Japan. Japan (No. 1), Chinese Taipei (No. 5), China (No. 8), Philippines (No. 13).

Prelims run through Oct. 2. Finals Oct. 3. LA28 qualification on the line. #Softball #AsianGames

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Japan enters the 2026 Asian Games as No. 1 in the world and host nation.

They are the team to beat in Anjō. China, Chinese Taipei, Philippines, South Korea all have something to prove.

Eight nations. Finals Oct. 3. The road to LA28 runs through Japan. #Softball #AsianGames2026

article.headline: Asian Games Women's Softball Opens in Anjō — Japan, Eight Nations Compete for LA28 Points

Up next: Lipscomb at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium — TOMORROW. #LadyVols #CollegeSoftball

stories.title: Texas Longhorns — Torres, Lincoln, Bordi Building the Three-Peat Roster

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Texas adds two key pieces for its three-peat run:

→ Isa Torres (FSU, .530 BA, 2026 national POY)
→ Samantha Lincoln (Texas Tech, pitcher)

Fall opener is TUESDAY — Sept. 29 vs. Murray State at McCombs Field. 6 PM CT. Free.

The Longhorns are building something. #HookEm #Softball

NFCA AAs Jocelyn Briski and Brooke Wells are back. So are freshmen AAs Vic Moten and Kaitlyn Pallozzi.

The Crimson Tide have unfinished business. Fall ball opens in October. #RollTide #Softball
